classification_definitions.unit: Local predicates/state/errors or synthetic API/feed; incidental setup does not qualify.
classification_definitions.integration: Material target assertion crosses actual production OS/file/protocol/store boundary.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent unit-only assertion blocks coexist with genuine production boundary assertions.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient mapping/source or source-visible assertion blocker; distinct from runtime UNKNOWN.
